title: Frederick Wolfe, German POW shot at Fort Knox

tellings.quote: he was a German soldier who after World War II was sent to Fort Knox as a prisoner of war.

plain: A German soldier named Frederick Wolfe was sent to Fort Knox, Kentucky, as a prisoner of war and was shot there. A former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen tells Michels the story without naming a source. In the telling he places it after the Second World War, though the story's date is 1944.
